cover: Before your prototype holds health data

slides.title: Is every user a real, invited account?
slides.body: Each person traced to an invitation, with two-factor sign-in. No dropdown of hard-coded names.

slides.title: Is access enforced in one place?
slides.body: Below every screen, where every query passes through it. An account that's set up wrong should see nothing.

slides.title: Are secrets a deliberate reveal?
slides.body: Sensitive fields hidden by default, shown only on purpose, with every reveal logged.

slides.title: Can you answer “who looked at this?”
slides.body: A log nobody can edit shows who viewed or changed any record, and when, with a timeline per record and per user.

slides.title: Are your session timeouts written down?
slides.body: HIPAA treats automatic logoff as addressable and names no duration. Assess it, pick the numbers, and record why.

slides.title: Will every vendor sign a BAA?
slides.body: Confirm every vendor touching the data will sign a business associate agreement before you build.
